name: Cream of Scallop Soup
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Clean scallops, reserve one-half cup and finely chop remainder.
Add these to milk, with seasonings and two tablespoons butter, and cook slowly twenty minutes.
Strain and thicken with remaining butter and flour cooked together.
Parboil reserved scallops, and add to soup.
Serve with small biscuits or oysterettes.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
